product_metadata.title: Malden International Designs Gilded Fallon Wash Picture Frame, 5x7, Gold
description: Transform the look of your home or office with this classic frame. This frame is able to hang horizontally or vertically or can be adorn on a mantel, desk or just about anywhere in your space, beautifully. With its simple yet elegant design it can be combined with other frames for a unique look. This item comes individually boxed which makes it perfect for a gift. For three generations Malden International Designs has been a family owned business, starting out in a small brick mill building in Malden Massachusetts. Since that time, they have grown into a leader of tabletop frames, wall frames and photo albums.
